mapper.select: select * from oa_goods_item order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_goods_item(goods_name, unit, stock, status, remark) values(#{goodsName}, #{unit}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update oa_goods_item set goods_name = #{goodsName}, unit = #{unit}, stock = #{stock}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
